# Exit codes

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ok` | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | `error` | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | `usage` | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 3 | `findings` | A --fail-on gate matched. The report is still written. |
| 4 | `auth` | Credentials were missing or rejected for every source the command needed. |
| 130 | `interrupted` | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

When more than one applies, the first error decides the code. A `--fail-on` match (3) is reported after the report is written.
